mapper.select: SELECT wh.id AS transactionId, wh.transaction_type AS transactionType, wh.amount AS amount, CASE WHEN wh.merchant_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.name ELSE wh.counterparty_name END AS counterpartyName, wh.status AS status, wh.created_at AS createdAt FROM wallet_histories wh LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = wh.merchant_id WHERE wh.wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY wh.created_at DESC, wh.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT wh.id AS transactionId, wh.trace_id AS traceId, wh.transaction_type AS transactionType, wh.amount AS amount, CASE WHEN wh.transaction_type IN ('PAYMENT', 'PAYMENT_CANCEL') THEN m.name ELSE wh.counterparty_name END AS counterpartyName, wh.target_bank_code AS targetBankCode, wh.target_account_number AS targetAccountNumber, wh.memo AS memo, wh.status AS status, wh.failure_code AS failureCode, wh.created_at AS createdAt, wl.ledger_type AS ledgerType, wl.balance_before AS balanceBefore, wl.balance_after AS balanceAfter, m.category AS merchantCategory FROM wallet_histories wh LEFT JOIN wallet_ledgers wl ON wl.history_id = wh.id AND wl.wallet_id = wh.wallet_id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = wh.merchant_id WHERE wh.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND wh.id = #{transactionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_histories ( wallet_id, trace_id, transaction_type, amount, merchant_id, memo, status, failure_code ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{traceId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{merchantId}, #{memo}, #{status}, #{failureCode} )

INSERT INTO wallet_ledgers ( history_id, wallet_id, ledger_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{walletId}, #{ledgerType}, #{amount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter} )
